title: Score a point
description: In any sport or board game, score a single point. You must follow all the rules of the game.

title: Guess your elevation
description: Carfax Tower sits at 72m above sea level. Guess your current elevation to within 10%

title: Water pong
description: Throw a ball into a cup of water from at least 2 metres away. The cup and ball may be makeshift.

title: Melt something
description: Heat any solid object until it becomes liquid.

title: Pet a pet
description: Touch a pet. If the owner is present, you must ask permission.

title: Solve a puzzle
description: In any physical newspaper, completely solve a puzzle. You may not look up the answers.

title: Catch your food
description: Obtain a food item and throw it into your own mouth. The throw must peak above your head.

title: Cry
description: Produce a single tear by whatever means necessary.

title: Get thanked
description: Get 5 different strangers to thank you verbally.

title: Tell the time
description: Start a timer. Without looking at any clocks or other timed events, stop the timer after 5 minutes, within half a minute.

title: Ace a maths minute
description: Achieve full marks on a standard maths minute.

title: Fail a maths minute spectacularly
description: Answer every question in a maths minute. Your answers must have no digits in common with the correct answer. Two of you must complete this challenge on the same attempt.

title: Balancing act
description: Place a leaf on your head and walk the full length of the longest street on your block without it falling off. You may not attach the leaf to your head or hair.

title: Break a law from Crime Spree
description: Check the [relevant map](https://www.google.com/maps/d/u/0/edit?mid=11ncXh-x6-hBPaOXRW5Y_b5uXiOu-3wVO&usp=drive-link) and perform any action described at any location.

title: Advertise JL:OX
description: Make a leaflet or poster for Jet Lag: Oxford, including our logo and this entire challenge description, then display it in public.

title: Choreograph a dance
description: Choreograph and perform a dance. The dance must contain 10 different moves, and all team members must perform the dance simultaneously.

title: Build a tower
description: Using any materials you like, build a free-standing tower which is at least one metre tall.

title: Forge a graffito
description: Find and trace a piece of graffiti. If you cannot trace it, recreate it as accurately as possible.

title: Litter picking
description: Find five pieces of litter and put them in the correct bin. You may not split litter into more pieces.

title: Critique some architecture
description: Go to the largest building in your region and say or write five things you like about it and five things you would change about it.

title: High five
description: High five a stranger. You may not ask them to high five you.

title: Post a letter
description: Write a letter with your home address and at least 100 words describing your surroundings, then post it in a postbox.

title: Compose a poem
description: Write a poem describing your surroundings, at least 30 words and 4 lines long, obeying a consistent meter or rhyme scheme

title: Review a bunch of benches
description: Sit on three different benches, and give each one a star rating with a reason.

title: Catch a critter
description: Catch an insect or bug in some kind of container, name it, then release it.

title: Play hopscotch
description: Find or draw a hopscotch court of at least 8 spaces and play a full round of hopscotch, using a stone as a marker.

title: Ascend a hundred steps
description: Consecutively or not, one player must ascend a total of 100 steps.

title: Make a trade
description: Not counting money, successfully trade something with a stranger.

title: Calculate average frequency
description: Find a bus timetable and calculate the average interval between buses arriving over a 24 hour period. Use this to find the average number of buses per hour.

title: Make a musical instrument
description: Using any materials, construct something with which you can produce a recognisable tune.

title: Fly a paper aeroplane
description: Make and throw a paper aeroplane. It must travel at least 30 feet.

title: Predict traffic flow
description: At any pedestrian crossing, either predict the number of cars that will cross it in 5 minutes, or predict the time in minutes it will take for the next car to cross it. Your answer must be 1 or higher, and must be accurate within 10%.

title: Find today's date
description: Find today's date in writing. You may not write it yourselves.

title: Charge your phone
description: Through whatever means, get your phone to successfully charge.

title: Geocaching
description: Find and sign a geocache.

title: Feed a bird
description: Buy any food safe for birds to eat and feed it to any bird.

title: Wear a non-hat hat
description: Wear something on your head that was not made to be headgear. It must remain on your head until you complete your next challenge, otherwise you automatically veto.

title: Climb a tree
description: Find a tree with a trunk at least one foot thick, and climb it to a height of at least 6 feet above ground.

title: Spell a street name
description: Find every letter in the full name of any street in the area on other signs. The signs must be outside, you may not use street name signs, and you may not use the same sign twice.

title: Land bottle flips
description: Flip a partially filled bottle so that it completes a somersault and lands upright. Each team member must complete this challenge.

title: Score a goal
description: Make some goalposts at most 8 yards apart and kick a ball through them from a distance of 12 yards.

title: Crown your ally
description: Craft a crown out of any material, and bestow it to a teammate ceremonially. They must wear this crown until you take a new tower. If they stop for any reason, repeat the ceremony at the original location

title: Exercise class
description: Do 5 cartweels, 10 burpees, 15 squats or 20 starjumps.

title: Count out your steps
description: Estimate the number of steps it will take you to cross the region. Walk it in exactly this many steps. You get one guess and one attempt.

title: Donate to charity
description: In any provable way, contribute financially to a charitable organisation.

title: Design a flag
description: Design a flag for the area. It must include at least 3 colours and at least 3 features, and each team member must contribute.

title: Hug the trees
description: Hug every tree in the region.

title: Trace silhouettes
description: Find something at least 4 feet tall casting a shadow onto dirt, sand, or gravel. Trace its shadow's outline.

title: Mimic some models
description: Find a person on an advert or poster and mimic their pose and facial expression for 30 seconds.

title: Propogate a plant
description: Find a small wild plant and take a cutting, plant it, then water it.

title: Make a putt
description: Putt a ball into a cup from at least 2 metres away. The cup, ball, and club may be makeshift, but the club must be at least two feet long.

title: Talk without fifth glyphs
description: Craft (or buy from a charity shop) and don an ascot or similar formal cloth, stand on public sitting apparatus, then impart your opinions about a topic of your choosing, lasting a minimum of 30 ticks. No words you say may contain 'e'. Writing flashcards is okay.

title: Parrot an animal sound
description: Copy a sound vocalised by a non-human animal.

title: Make a sandwich
description: Put two foodstuffs between two slices of bread and take a bite

title: Shout it out
description: Stand at least 10 metres apart, with a road, river, or path between you. Get a teammate to repeat a sentence from the Nonsense Generator by shouting it to them.

title: Return a shopping basket
description: In any shop, find a misplaced shopping basket and return it to the stacks.

title: Experience paredolia
description: Take photos of 4 objects resembling faces. You may not use objects that are supposed to look like animals or humans.

title: Transfer the texture of trees
description: Find a forest, then use a pencil to copy the texture of 6 different trees onto a single piece of paper.

title: Have your five a day
description: Your team must eat a total of five fruits or vegetables. As long as you are in this region, all teammates can contribute.

title: Name fifty women
description: It's as simple as it sounds. They must be real women.

title: Discover documented life
description: Find a pictoral represetation of an animal or plant and then find it in the wild. It must at least be in the same taxonomic family.

title: Copy Wikipedia
description: Search Wikipedia for a photograph taken of the local area. Take a photograph from the same location and angle.

title: Jog the perimeter
description: Jog around the entire perimeter of the region.

title: Bat a ball
description: Bat a ball. The ball must be thrown from a distance of at least 22 yards, and the bat may be anything, but must be no longer than 33 inches and no wider than 4 inches. You have three attempts. Please do this somewhere safe!

title: Contribute to the water cycle
description: Collect at least a cup of water from a man-made source and pour it into a natural body of water.

title: Make a daisy chain
description: Make a daisy chain necklace and photograph one team member wearing it.

title: Leave a review
description: Visit either the highest or lowest rated landmark in the area and leave a review of it on your chosen review site, making at least 2 points with photo evidence.

title: Span an alley
description: Find an alley. Touch both walls simultaneously. If you can't do it alone, form a chain.

title: Find a feather
description: Get a feather of any kind and take it here.

title: Become a weedkiller
description: Identify 10 plants as weeds and uproot them.

title: Shoot a hoop
description: Throw any round object through any circular ring

title: Find the sun and moon
description: Find either symbolic or photographic pictures of the sun and the moon.

title: Build an archway
description: Build a freestanding archway with a clearance of at least 10cm.

title: Follow your destiny
description: Generate a random number from 1 to 102 then visit the region with that ID

title: Float a boat
description: Construct a concave boat and place it on the surface of any body of water. It must float for at least 10 seconds.

title: Lure an opponent
description: Get an opponent to enter this region.

title: Quarter something
description: Split any object into four parts of equal shape and size.

title: Dust the windows
description: Scrub the entire area of every ground-floor window of any buildling.

title: Burst a bubble
description: Find or blow a bubble, and then pop it.

title: Contact the council
description: Call, email, or visit the local council to ask on any matter. You must receive an accurate answer to your query.

title: Limbo dilemma
description: Make a choice: succeed at a limbo below 2 feet in 5 attempts, 3 feet in 3 attempts, or 4 feet in 1 attempt.

title: Cartography
description: Trace the shape of this region then colour it in. Be careful not to go over the lines!

title: Make it #aesthetic
description: Take a selection of 10 photos of the local area that encapsulate its aesthetic. Upload these photos to social media, with a different filter on each one.

title: Play marbles
description: Play marbles on a paved area. You may use any hard balls as marbles.

title: Lost and found
description: Leave any possession in this region and get another teammate not currently in this region or any neighbouring regions to retrieve it.

title: Draw in detail
description: Draw a building adjacent to your region. A teammate who is not present must correctly identify the building. Each teammate gets one guess. You may not write anything.

title: Total a menu
description: Find a menu and mentally calculate the total cost of every item on it. Check your answer with a calculator. If you were wrong, pick another menu and start over.

title: Write a rhyme
description: Compose a rhyme incorporating various product names from a local establishment. It must include at least 4 and be at least 8 lines long.

title: Describe something simply
description: One of you must go into a shop or park and describe something you can see with at most ten monosyllabic words. A teammate who is elsewhere must guess what you are describing.

title: Take a closer look
description: Take a photo of 3 items with the camera no more than 2cm from the subject. Your elsewhere teammates must then identify the things from these photos.

title: Point north
description: Without looking at any digital devices, determine and point in the direction of north.

title: Run for it
description: Reach any spawn point in 5 minutes

title: Improve an advert
description: Find any advertisement and create your own advert for the same product. It must include the same factual information, such as price.

title: Celebrate a bus
description: Go to a bus stop where only one bus will arrive in the next five minutes. Wait for a bus to arrive, and chant "bus" when it appears.

title: Guess everyone's age
description: Guess the age of every current player. You must be no more than one year off. You must get at least 80%

title: Get faster, higher, stronger
description: In ten seconds, you must run 50 metres, go over something 1 metre high, and lift a teammate.

title: Run a slalom
description: Place eight objects in a line, at least one metre apart each. Run from one end of the line to the other, alternating the side by which you pass each object. You have five seconds.

title: Leak your location
description: Reveal to all players your current location. Do this for the next two regions you enter.

title: Win today's Wordle
description: You must succeed of your own accord.

title: Play a round of hangman
description: Provide your team with an eight-letter word to guess. They can make at most six mistakes.

title: Re-enact Jet Lag: The Game
description: Recreate any minute-long scene from Jet Lag: The Game from memory. You may rehearse, but if you make any mistakes, you must start over.

title: Make eighteen holes in one
description: Make 18 holes in any single object you find in this region.

title: Construct a pyramid
description: Stack six objects in a pyramid formation

title: Talk about transport
description: Get any stranger to say one of the following words: bus, train, plane, boat, car.

title: Gardening
description: Find some publicly accessible flowers and carefully water them.

title: Attempt divination
description: Guess which region your team will claim next. You may not inform your teammates of your guess. If you are incorrect, you may not guess the same block again.

title: Irregulate your breathing
description: Start a stopwatch. In the next two minutes, you may only inhale when the timer shows a prime number of seconds. If you inhale any other time, start over.

title: Draw out a drawing
description: Draw one unbroken line at least 1 metre long without crossing over itself. You must verify the length.

title: Reach a lucky roll
description: Roll a die at least 3 metres and landing on at least 3

title: Test your luck
description: Predict five coin flips in a row. You may keep flipping until you succeed.

title: Seduce and debauch an unallied player
description: On a two-minute call with any opponent, convince them to either temporarily team up with you, or slander each of their teammates on camera

title: Adopt a competing standard
description: Change your phone's keyboard to a different layout (e.g. Dvorak) and score more than 30wpm in a typing test.

title: Surf the Subway
description: Sustain a run of Subway Surfers for 90 seconds

title: Charity spree
description: Give away any two items to any strangers. They must accept your gifts.

title: Rebrand your clothing
description: Create and attach a JL:OX branded tag to an article of clothing. If you ever lose the tag, you must return here to reattach it.

title: Touch grass
description: Sit on the ground whilst touching some live grass for at least 30 seconds. You've earned it.

title: Review in rhymes
description: Submit two reviews for adjacent buildings, one with a 1 star rating, the other with a 5 star rating. Each must contain at least 100 words of your honest thoughts. Every sentence of one review must rhyme with a sentence in the other review.

title: Experience 3D rotations
description: Find a cuboidal object and take a photo of every face in four 90 degree rotations. Verify you have all 24 before continuing.

title: City Pride
description: Draw the flag of Oxford as accurately as possible

title: Big Brother
description: Draw a self portrait, write your name underneath, and hide it somewhere in this region with the eyes visible. If an opponent finds it, you are instantly KO'd, no matter where you are.

title: Get in sync with your team
description: Complete another teammate's current challenge at the exact same time as them.

title: The Floor is Lava
description: Cross the zone without stepping on the ground. Each player gets only one attempt.

title: Balancing Act 2
description: Walk along the entire length of a kerb. You must start and end at different zone boundaries. If you step off the kerb, start over.

title: Be at least 12 months old
description: Do each of the following: place a smaller thing into a larger container, wave at someone when they leave,  use your thumb and pointer finger to pick up small objects, pull yourself up into a standing position
